subject: Post-call: EmberCare inference playbook & qualification — recap + next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@embercare.ai>, Connor Lee <connor.lee@embercare.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: EmberCare inference playbook & qualification — recap + next steps

Alex / Connor — thanks again for the 30-minute demo and product-fit discussion earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please flag anything I missed.

High-level goals you stated:
- Replace parts of your on-prem audio-documentation pipeline with a cloud-hosted inference layer to reduce maintenance and shrink latency spikes.
- Provide re-ranking for clinical note search (embedding + rerank) with strict PII controls.
- Allow the mobile triage app to get streaming partial responses and structured JSON outputs for downstream ingestion.

Pain points called out:
- Current self-hosted runtime is brittle under peak load; cold-starts and KV cache churn cause 2–6s tail latency.
- Procurement/security requires SOC2 evidence and encryption-at-rest for embeddings.
- Need deterministic structured outputs for downstream clinical workflows (no hallucinated fields).

Redwood fit summary (what we discussed):
- Hosted API for quick go/no-go; Dedicated pools if you want capacity isolation and predictable throughput.
- Streaming + function-calls to support partial mobile responses + deterministic structured outputs via explicit schema enforcement.
- Embeddings + reranking workflow: prefix caching + batch embedding endpoint to reduce costs; we suggested 8-bit quantized model variant for rerank to save cost with minimal quality loss.
- Security: SOC2 compliance, VPC-peering option for Private connect, and KMS integration for key management.

Open technical items for confirmation (we need your answers):
1) Target P95 latency for mobile streaming and for rerank calls (approx values)
2) Expected concurrency for peak hours (users/minute or requests/second)
3) Any regulatory constraints that force on-prem only (HIPAA-ish mention)
4) Sample document schema for structured outputs (we attached sample-schema.yaml)

Proposed next steps / owners / timing:
- Alex: share sample schema and a short dev contact who can run a quick SDK PoC (you said Connor could help) — by Fri 2026-07-24.
- Connor: send procurement contact and any vendor paperwork checklist — by Fri 2026-07-24.
- Ben (Redwood Solutions): I'll schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive and PoC plan to cover streaming integration, function calling, and embedding pipelines — propose Mon 2026-07-27.
- Hannah: deliver short MRAP/Security answers and attach baseline evidence we discussed (attached).

Attachments: embercare-mrap-answers.pdf (short answers to security Qs), sample-schema.yaml (example structured output schema)

If that all looks good I’ll create an internal PoC ticket and share a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive. Thanks again — great alignment on use cases.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Cc: Connor Lee <connor.lee@embercare.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: EmberCare inference playbook & qualification — recap + next steps

Thanks Hannah — great notes. Couple quick clarifications and answers below.

Answers to your open items:
1) Target latency: mobile streaming P95 ~800ms end-to-end for short prompts (~150 tokens). Rerank P95 target ~400ms for top-10 re-rank requests.
2) Peak concurrency: our app can spike to ~60 requests/sec during morning triage (US PST). Typical sustained is ~8–12 rps.
3) Regulatory: HIPAA applies; we prefer managed Private with VPC-peering but are open to Hosted for initial PoC if we isolate PHI and use tokenization/PII stripping.
4) Schema: attaching a quick schema and a sample record; Connor will send the full schema and a sanitized dataset.

Procurement contact: procurement@embercare.ai (I carbon-copied them on the next mail).

We’re good to move forward with a PoC. Mon 2026-07-27 morning PST works for me for a 60-minute deep-dive. Connor — are you available to join?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product, EmberCare
alex.rivera@embercare.ai
